header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Endure Hardships and difficulties when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah

blocks.text: forsake Islaam. However, Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) kept refusing. The emperor then had him untied and commanded his men to fill a cauldron with water and bring it to a boil. Two Muslim prisoners were then brought and one of them was thrown into the cauldron. (After showing him this) The emperor again asked Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) to become a Christian, but he again refused. The emperor then gave orders that Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) should be thrown into the cauldron.

As Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) was being led to the cauldron, he began weeping. When the emperor was informed about this, he thought that Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) was frightened, so he called him back. Again he asked Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) to become a Christian, but the offer was again refused. The emperor then asked, "Then what made you weep?" Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) replied, "I wept when I thought to myself that once I am thrown into the fire, I will be killed instantly. I wish that I had as many lives as the hairs on my body so that each one could be given for the pleasure of Allaah."

The tyrant said, "Would you kiss my head in exchange for your freedom?" Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) asked, "In exchange for all the prisoners?" The emperor agreed, "In exchange for all the prisoners." Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) said to himself, "Although he is an enemy of Allaah, I don't mind kissing his head in exchange for my freedom as well as the freedom of all the Muslim prisoners." Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) therefore drew closer and kissed his head, after which all the prisoners were handed over to him.

Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) then brought them all back to Hadhrat Umar (RA). When Hadhrat Umar (RA) was informed about the events, he said, "It is compulsory for every Muslim to kiss the head of Abdullaah bin Hudhaafa (RA) and I shall be the first." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then stood up and kissed his head (so that Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) should forget the unpleasant experience of kissing the emperor's head).[^1]
The Hardships and Difficulties Endured by the Sahabah (RA) in General
The Torture the Sahabah (RA) Suffered at the Hands of the Mushrikeen

Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Jubayr narrates that he once asked Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA), "Was the torture that the Mushrikeen put the Sahabah (RA) through so severe that they would have been excused if they had to forsake Islaam?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) replied, "Certainly. By Allaah! The Mushrikeen would beat one of the Muslims up and keep him so hungry and thirsty that he would be unable to even sit up because of his intense suffering.
